sections.heading: Loss details
fields: Harbor Point Shopping Center parking lot, 2200 block of Harbor Ave, Maple Harbor, OR

sections.heading: What happened (in your own words)
sections.paragraph: I was driving slowly through the Harbor Point Shopping Center parking lot looking for a space. A gray pickup truck backed out of a parking space on my right and hit the back right corner of my SUV. The rear bumper is pushed in, the back right side panel is dented and scraped, and the right taillight is broken. Nobody was hurt. The other driver and I exchanged information, and a police officer came and took a report.

sections.heading: Damage to your vehicle
fields: Rear bumper; Right rear quarter panel; Right tail lamp
Rear bumper pushed in at the right corner; right rear quarter panel dented and scraped; right tail lamp broken.
